about_the_game:
Darkstrand is a hardcore, realistic extraction shooter set in the year 2042, nearly 2 decades after a catastrophic viral outbreak wiped out most over humanity. governments have fallen, nations have fractured, and the remnants of civilization are controlled by Mega corporations and the last standing official military power the United Nations.

You will play as a Special Response Service (SRS) Operative, Deploying into hostile territories to recover valuable technology, resources and intelligence from contaminated zones filled with mutants, insurgents and rival corporate SRS teams. Every mission carries high risk and even higher reward.

Core Features

  • Hardcore Extraction Gameplay:
    Enter dangerous zones, gather weapons, data, and resources, then extract alive to keep what you’ve earned. Death means losing everything you brought in.

  • Global Conflict Setting:
    Explore multiple regions across the world, from frozen arctic ruins to quarantined mega cities and collapsed industrial zones. Each map offers unique terrain, threats, and environmental hazards.

  • Faction-Based Warfare:
    Choose allegiance between the United Nations or one of four rival corporations—each with unique goals, gear, and SRS unit doctrines. Your employer determines your missions, enemies, and rewards.

  • Realistic Gunplay & Tactical Combat:
    Experience close to true-to-life weapon handling, ballistics, and sound design. Every bullet counts—there are no hit markers, no second chances.

  • Progression & Customization:
    Earn money, weapons, and attachments from successful extractions. Upgrade your loadouts, customize weapon systems, and unlock high-tier gear to survive longer and fight harder.

  • Dynamic Missions:
    Every operation is different. Objectives, weather, and enemy patrols change each time you deploy, ensuring no two missions ever play the same.

  • Survival & Immersion:
    Manage stamina, bleeding, infections, and gear weight. The world is unforgiving—both enemies and the environment are out to kill you.

content_descriptors.notes: The game depicts heavy violence with the player competing with others in gunfights. When players are hurt they use drugs as painkillers.
